preflight: Call the compact full-request admission for exactly 560 sweeps before authenticating pilots or invoking proof, model preparation, or training.
measurement: One complete library call plus canonical JSON serialization and SHA-256 through the existing measurement helper. Phase wrappers use perf_counter and process_time and add instrumentation overhead.
instrumentation_overhead: Reversible Python wrappers add dispatch and event-recording overhead; these phase timings are diagnostic only.
interpretation: Inclusive nested phase durations are not disjoint and must not be summed. This is a single instrumented profile, not a primary median, same-work comparison, speed claim, or RSS measurement.
acceptance: Require a clean committed source snapshot before the call and the identical snapshot after it. Require the complete report to match the independently replayed compact pilot semantic digest. Preserve a failed call and traceback; never retry.
